name: deepscientist-lite-web
description: Public-only web acquisition and provenance records for DeepScientist Lite.

interface.shortDescription: Acquire public sources with explicit provenance and limits.
interface.longDescription: An experimental public-only web pack. It records backend capabilities and source provenance, forbids authenticated browsing and form submission in v1, and treats Playwright CLI, Firecrawl, Tapestry, and agent-browser as optional external backends.
defaultPrompt: Use $ds-lite-web to acquire public evidence within an explicit domain and resource budget.
